# Isha Systems LLC

> Fully-managed website subscription for small businesses in the United States and Canada. We design, build, host, and maintain your website for $0 upfront and $29.99/month. After 12 months, the website code is transferred to you — fully owned, forever.

Isha Systems LLC is a subscription-based web design and hosting service. We handle everything — design, development, domain, business email, hosting, SSL, SEO, and ongoing maintenance — so small business owners don't have to. Sites typically go live within 7 days.

## Core Offering

- **Setup fee:** $0 — no upfront cost web development.
- **Monthly subscription:** $29.99/month, cancel anytime.
- **Code ownership:** subscribe for 12 months and the full website code is transferred to you to own forever.
- **Turnaround:** live website delivered in about 7 days.
- **Markets served:** United States and Canada.

## What's Included

- Up to 10 custom-designed, handcrafted pages.
- Free domain name.
- Free business email.
- Free managed web hosting.
- Free SSL certificate.
- Mobile-optimized, responsive design.
- Basic SEO setup.
- Contact form integration.
- Multi-language support (English and Spanish).
- Ongoing maintenance, updates, and support.

## Why Choose Isha Systems

- Engineer-built websites — an affordable alternative to Squarespace, Wix, and traditional agencies.
- Transparent pricing with no hidden fees and no surprise bills.
- Domain, email, and hosting bundled free (typically $200+/year elsewhere).
- You ultimately own your website code.

## Portfolio

- **PyPyCode.com** — technology / coding education website.
- **Mavi Collision Center** — automotive collision repair website.
- **Kid Buzz Daily** — kids news and content website.
- **League of Tennis** — sports league website.

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS v4, with built-in i18n for English/Spanish.
